title: The Quantity a Drying Pass Is Charged On
content:
Which bushels the pass is charged on follows what has been worked. This rule governs conditioning charges on Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements and reads what the storage account shows of earlier conditioning and of grain having left store.

## Basis of the charge

Where a conditioning charge already stands on the storage account and no bushels have left store since the grain went in, the pass is charged on the bushels the most recent conditioning charge was raised on, the same grain having been worked again.

Where bushels have left store since the grain went in, the pass is charged on the bushels standing in store.

And otherwise the pass is charged on the bushels the most recent load into store was taken in on.

## The quantity named in the middle line

The bushels standing in store are backed out of the storage account, being the bushels taken into store less the bushels taken off for shrink and less the bushels loaded out.

## Truth table of the conditions

| A conditioning charge already stands on the account | Bushels have left store since the grain went in | Charged on |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | no | the bushels the most recent conditioning charge was raised on |
| yes | yes | the bushels standing in store |
| no | yes | the bushels standing in store |
| no | no | the bushels the most recent load into store was taken in on |

Where bushels have left store, the quantity is the bushels standing in store whether or not the grain has been through the dryer before; where nothing has left and nothing has been dried, the quantity is the most recent load taken in.

## Worked quantities, on hypothetical accounts

**An account showing one earlier conditioning charge raised on 9200 bushels and no grain having left store.** The pass is charged on 9200 bushels.

**An account showing 16000 bushels taken in, 180 taken off for shrink and 3000 loaded out, with an earlier conditioning charge on the record.** Grain has left store, so the pass is charged on the bushels standing in store, which is 12820.

**An account showing two loads in, of 4000 and 5500 bushels, with no conditioning charge and nothing having left store.** The pass is charged on the most recent load, which is 5500 bushels.
